One Platform. 

Endless Possibilities.

Datarails FP&A

Datarails FP&A is a robust financial planning and analysis solution that enables finance team to benefit from consolidation, reporting, budgeting, and planning. It includes data visualization tools, collaborative workflows, and a complete access to Datarails AI, our AI-powered capabilities to help finance teams make smarter, faster decisions.

Request a Demo

Datarails Cash Management

Datarails Cash Management gives finance teams clear, real-time visibility into their cash position. It simplifies the complexities of managing multiple bank accounts by automatically categorizing transactions and providing up-to-date balances across entities. With built-in cash forecasting, Excel-based drill-down capabilities, and support for entity-level management, teams can make smarter decisions and stay ahead of their liquidity needs.

Request a Demo

Datarails Month-End Close

Datarails Month-End Close streamlines and simplifies the close process for finance teams. It brings all tasks, reconciliations, and documentation into one centralized workspace, making it easier to stay organized and on track. With built-in visibility across the entire close timeline and support for multi-entity and intercompany operations

Request a Demo

Datarails Connect

Datarails Connect focuses on providing real-time consolidation and reporting capabilities, along with data visualization tools and partial access to Datarails AI. It is the ideal solution for teams looking to enhance their reporting and analytics without the full FP&A functionality.

Request a Demo
